python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
files = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), *Path('docs/adrs').glob('000[12]-*.md')]
checked = 0
for path in files:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = path.parent / name if name else path
        assert destination.is_file(), (path, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', destination.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in slugs, (path, target)
        checked += 1
print(f'Checked {checked} local documentation links and their anchors.')
PY
